responsibility: Implements the per-device auxiliary data registry used by channel device modules. It allocates unique ModuleId objects, stores linked lists of module-specific data records in each DeviceTable, validates module ids through RTentity, returns attached state to device implementations such as ClientSocket, MemStream, and ProgramArgs, and invokes registered free procedures when attached data is removed.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the RTdata pair: rather than just declaring attachment routines like RTdata.def, it defines ModuleId records, keeps per-device ModuleData linked lists, validates module ids with RTentity membership, and runs registered free callbacks during removal.
